If blocked: skip Stage B, enter repair

"awaiting_manual_fill" is a fifth status this pipeline does not itself
produce: story_requests/authoring_plan.py parks a skeleton_fill job there
BEFORE this diagram's flow ever runs, when the admin picks mechanism=skill
(a human/skill fills the skeleton offline instead of an LLM call). It is
resumed later via generation/import_story.py's resume function (invoked by
import_cli.py --job), which runs the filled story through the same
validator gate + persist + moderation pipeline and settles it to "passed"
or "needs_review" (a hard gate block instead settles it to "failed").
Why a harness loop and not a firmer prompt:
every stage prompt already states a
Flesch-Kincaid target, and stating it does
not work, because a language model cannot
count syllables and so cannot evaluate the
constraint it is given. AL-288 measured six
books written to an explicit "FK 4-6" target
and five cleared the band's 7.0 upper edge
anyway. AL-292 is the paired control: same
prompt, same target, the author who
instrumented reading level in the harness
reached whole-book FK 5.12 with 84% of nodes
in band, the one who did not reached FK 8.35
Its abort condition is stronger than Stage
C's rather than weaker: a revision is kept
only when the MEASURED score improved, so
It never blocks. RL-13 stays a WARNING, and

report even when nothing was revised,
